scoring.formula: opportunityScore = round(D*R*C*F / 625 * 100), each factor an integer 1-5 (max 625 -> 100)

factors.D: Search demand tier, ESTIMATED from query type (head/mid/long-tail, local vs national). Not a measured volume.
factors.R: Business relevance: 5 = explicitly offered service with project evidence; 1 = not offered
factors.C: Conversion potential: likelihood the searcher hires/contacts (transactional/local high, informational low)
factors.F: Ranking feasibility for a new, low-authority site: long-tail/local/evidence-specific high; national head terms low

scoring.replacement: The keyword intelligence agent replaces D with observed GSC/Bing impressions (log-scaled to 1-5) once data exists, and stores the measured values alongside the estimate.
